gate: D2FC2 independent NF-kB generator/modal and publication-native validation-observability test

epistemic_record.role: bounded independent external qualification and Limit Map evidence under repaired implementation of the pre-existing freeze

interpretation: The independent D2FC2 NF-kB model contains two numerically stable complex-conjugate local mode pairs. The frozen pair-selection rule therefore refuses a unique scalar chi_bio rather than choosing a favorable pair after viewing the spectrum. None of the five publication-defined held-out mean nuclear-RelA validation conditions supplies two peaks under the frozen empirical rule, so an empirical oscillatory frequency is also non-identifiable in this validation window. This preserves the Jaruszewicz scalar as a model-specific P0-Q-qualified candidate while strengthening the biological Limit Map: NF-kB dynamics can require a modal representation because scalar reduction is not uniquely identifiable across model lineages.
